set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- cpp_transport consumes feasible G0 or explicitly rejects it.
- Distinct feasible one-step starts demonstrate expected backend sensitivity.
- C++ and lpSolve backends agree from the same G0 within justified tolerance.
- Invalid shape, negativity, non-finite values, and marginal violations fail early.
- Warm-start behavior has regression and iteration-accounting tests.
set.title: Honor warm starts across exact GW and FGW backends
